entries.name: NeuroBreath
entries.introduction: Follow the living neural orb through three gentle, clearly timed breathing experiences. Choose a rhythm, pause whenever you need, and return at your own pace.
entries.purpose: Offer a visual focus for comfortable paced breathing and a quiet transition into rest or attention.
entries.audience: People who can comfortably follow written breathing instructions and choose whether a timing pattern suits them.
entries.age_guidance: No validated age rating is established; children should use breathing activities with appropriate adult guidance.
entries.difficulty: Fixed timing patterns, with no score or requirement to complete a session. Comfort is more important than keeping pace.
entries.languages: English instructions in this website preview.
entries.status: Three functional local web guides. Production publication and product-specific efficacy are not established.
objectives: Notice the transition between breathing phases.
Use an optional visual rhythm without forcing the breath.
Pause or leave freely; no streak, score or completion pressure.
offers: Square Focus follows four equal phases around a square. Sleep Calm uses a shorter hold and longer exhalation along an open path. Neural Wave alternates inhalation and exhalation without a holding phase.

Each guide uses the original NeuroBreath artwork, a shared elapsed-time clock and visible phase labels. Start, Pause, Resume, Restart and Exit are available. The animation supports reduced-motion preferences.

interaction.see: The original blue-and-gold neural orb, an activity path, the current phase and remaining seconds.
interaction.hear: These web guides do not include spoken narration or breathing sounds.
interaction.do: Choose one of the three activities. Start only when comfortable, follow the written phase and use Pause whenever needed.
interaction.feedback: Phase, countdown and cycle number communicate timing. There is no score or judgement of how you breathe.
interaction.progression: Timing repeats until you pause or leave; sessions do not become harder automatically.
interaction.help: Read the instructions below each guide. Pause before leaving; Exit returns to NeuroBreath. Returning after the page is hidden requires explicit Resume.

tutorial.title: Choose a comfortable rhythm
tutorial.text: Compare the three timing patterns below. A pattern with holds is optional; Neural Wave has no hold phase.

tutorial.title: Settle before starting
tutorial.text: Sit or rest comfortably. Read the full sequence, then press Start when ready.

tutorial.title: Follow without forcing
tutorial.text: Use the changing orb and written labels as a gentle guide. You do not need to match a timer if it feels uncomfortable.

tutorial.title: Pause or finish
tutorial.text: Pause whenever you need, Resume to continue or Restart from the beginning. Exit returns to this platform.

entries.name: Square Focus
entries.introduction: An even four-part rhythm for attending to each change of phase.
entries.purpose: An even four-part rhythm for attending to each change of phase.
entries.audience: People who can comfortably follow written breathing instructions and choose whether a timing pattern suits them.
entries.age_guidance: No validated age rating is established; children should use breathing activities with appropriate adult guidance.
entries.difficulty: 4–4–4–4 · 16 seconds per cycle. There is no score or automatic increase in difficulty.
entries.languages: English instructions in this website preview.
entries.status: Three functional local web guides. Production publication and product-specific efficacy are not established.
objectives: Follow a square through a repeating 4–4–4–4 rhythm.
Practise paying attention to phase changes at a comfortable pace.
offers: The highlighted trace travels around four sides. The orb expands on inhalation, maintains its size during the first hold, contracts on exhalation and stays smaller during the final hold.
Use the phase labels and seconds as the timing reference. The animation is a guide, not a measurement of your breathing. Stop if dizziness or discomfort occurs; do not force a hold.

interaction.see: The highlighted trace travels around four sides. The orb expands on inhalation, maintains its size during the first hold, contracts on exhalation and stays smaller during the final hold.
interaction.hear: These web guides do not include spoken narration or breathing sounds.
interaction.do: Press Start, then follow inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds. Pause as needed.
interaction.feedback: The gold phase highlight, countdown and cycle number update from the same clock. The orb follows the current phase; reduced-motion settings suppress movement.
interaction.progression: Timing repeats until you pause or leave; sessions do not become harder automatically.
interaction.help: Read the instructions below each guide. Pause before leaving; Exit returns to NeuroBreath. Returning after the page is hidden requires explicit Resume.

tutorial.title: Get comfortable
tutorial.text: Read the sequence and settle in a comfortable position. Use gentle, unforced breathing; skip this pattern if its holds or pace do not suit you.

tutorial.title: Start the guide
tutorial.text: Press Start. The guide begins with inhalation and shows the phase name and remaining seconds.

tutorial.title: Inhale · 4 seconds
tutorial.text: Breathe in gently as the orb opens.

tutorial.title: Hold · 4 seconds
tutorial.text: Allow the indicated pause only if it feels comfortable. Never strain to hold your breath.

tutorial.title: Exhale · 4 seconds
tutorial.text: Let the breath flow out comfortably as the orb contracts.

tutorial.title: Hold · 4 seconds
tutorial.text: Allow the indicated pause only if it feels comfortable. Never strain to hold your breath.

tutorial.title: Continue, pause or leave
tutorial.text: Pause freezes the timing; Resume continues from that point. Restart begins a new cycle. Exit returns to NeuroBreath. The guide pauses if you hide the page or scroll it out of view.
